what: Luxury = most expensive ~10% of hotel-type listings on Booking.com (owner's rule, 14 Nov 2026). Star ratings ignored. One night, 2 adults, US$, cheapest available room, quoted 14 Nov 2026. Whole-home rental operators (Vacation STAY, Rinn) removed.

kyoto.universe: 373 hotel-type listings in August, 545 in April (Booking filter ht_id=204); only the 118 most expensive in April and 100 in August were loaded.
kyoto.note: Ranking on the low month biases the ratio down, ranking on the high month biases it up, so the truth sits between 1.7 and 2.2.

p0106.universe: 36 hotel/resort listings in September (Booking classes most Maui lodging as condos/apartments); 41 in December. Top 10% is only 4 hotels.

bookingWindowFinding: Booking.com shows only about 12 months of future dates: Tue 14 Dec 2027 returned 8 properties, so Dec 2027 could not be compared. A panel has to sit inside the next ~12 months and be quoted the same day.
caveats: Kyoto April and August quoted at different lead times (5 vs 9 months); Maui Dec at 1 month vs Sep at 10 months.
Cheapest available room for one night; a near-sold-out date can leave only suites (Hilton Kyoto 4.4x, Ace Hotel 3.5x).
Maui 15 Dec misses the Christmas-New Year peak that the official December average includes.
